reason: The kernel adapters, platform state semantics and MCP/shell composition presently require one source closure and one qualification event.
Their initial versions will change together while legacy Seams are crossed.
Three repositories would introduce version coordination and provenance crossings without an observed independent lifecycle.
A package boundary is sufficient to enforce dependency direction and makes a later repository split mechanical if lifecycle evidence appears.
This is a CommonReduction of repository machinery, not a collapse of kernel/platform/shell semantic distinctions.
The existing repository is already the closest declared owner and prevents creation of a parallel platform authority.

root.migrationConstraint: The accepted root currently owns the generic application host and production-release closure. Initial replacement work must be architecture-only and must not alter its package.json, release scripts, deployment, runtime dependencies or selected source.
